description: Installs zitadel-pgrst-app with the products fixture. Verifies the check templates (SPA reachable + PostgREST schema exposed). Demo-seed is OFF — first iteration validates the deploy pipeline; UI-flow tests (Playwright) come in a follow-up. addon-oidc creates the OIDC client in Zitadel; addon-ssl belongs on the nginx dependency (not on us — we have no own container).
